reply: ower-law and log terms did not isolate a few-term form. The full 54–120-term linear bases fit to about 1e-7–1e-13, but with large cancelling coefficients, so they are overfit rather than the law. Nonlinear-exponent forms reached 4e-3 to 1e-2, and the last hand-built 10-term candidate reached 1.1e-2.
